verdict.rationale: DPMA offers online services such as the DEPATISnet and DPMAregister databases and the DPMAdirektWeb/DPMAdirektPro e-filing routes. A test or sandbox environment for these filing or register interfaces is a fair thing to ask of a service like this, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions a sandbox, test environment, or way to try submissions without touching real records, so the verdict is none rather than na.
